title: (RHBA-2016:1933) Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.3 Release Advisory
portal_summary: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.3, which fixes several bugs and includes various enhancements, is now available.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.3 Release Advisory
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.3|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, ensure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For instructions on new installations, see the following documentation:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/3.3/install_config/install/planning.html

For instructions on how to properly upgrade existing clusters to OpenShift Container Platform 3.3, see the following documentation:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/3.3/install_config/upgrading/
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (formerly OpenShift Enterprise) is the company's cloud computing Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution designed for on-premise or private cloud deployments.

The OpenShift Container Platform 3.3 Release Notes provide information about new features, bug fixes, and known issues:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/3.3/release_notes/ocp_3_3_release_notes.html

This advisory contains the RPM packages for this release. See the following advisory for the container images for this release:

https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHBA-2016:1934
